hikes.name: Fort Rock
hikes.blurb: Into a horseshoe of tuff cliffs, an old volcano once lapped by an ice-age lake.

hikes.name: Crack in the Ground
hikes.blurb: Walk inside a 70-foot-deep volcanic fissure in the high desert.

hikes.name: Hager Mountain Lookout
hikes.blurb: A climb to a staffed lookout over Summer Lake's basin and the Fort Rock country.

hikes.name: Gearhart Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Lookout Rock Trailhead, an 11.3-mile round trip to the top of Gearhart Mountain (8,361 ft), with about 2,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Crane Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Crane Mountain Trailhead, a 9.3-mile round trip to the top of Crane Mountain (8,326 ft), with about 1,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Fir Timber Butte
hikes.blurb: From Chewaucan Crossing Trailhead, an 8.6-mile round trip to the top of Fir Timber Butte (6,278 ft), with about 2,200 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Ennis Butte
hikes.blurb: From Chewaucan Crossing Trailhead, a 6.9-mile round trip to the top of Ennis Butte (6,747 ft), with about 2,050 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Crane Mountain Viewpoint
hikes.blurb: From Crane Mountain Trailhead, an 8.2-mile round trip to Crane Mountain Viewpoint, with about 1,900 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: North Warner Viewpoint
hikes.blurb: From South Fork Crooked Creek Trailhead, a 9.8-mile round trip to North Warner Viewpoint, with about 1,650 feet of climbing.
